snippet_primary: "Used to be handmade items, made with love and care. Now its just a platform for lots of rubbish from China which is incorrectly sized, poor material (unlikely to conform to UK H&S) and awful service. Have to pay through the nose to return items to other countries and no cover for items that go missing. Better off throwing money in the bin."
subject_exact: buyer's complaint that Etsy shifted from handmade goods to low-quality mass-produced items from China
local_qualifiers: unlikely to conform to UK H&S
no cover for items that go missing
